# Deju Studio - Full Site Content

> Deju Studio is an ultra-premium private nail studio in Ubud, Bali, founded and operated by nail artist Desty Zulfa Nabila. The studio specialises in Russian manicure technique, structured gel and BIAB, soft tip / Gel-X / polygel / sculpture extensions, and hand-painted luxury nail art from minimalist to 4D. Bookings are by WhatsApp only.

Site: https://www.dejustudio.com/
Location: Jl. Tirta Tawar, Petulu, Ubud, Bali 80571, Indonesia
Booking: WhatsApp +62 823 4088 9808
Instagram: @dejustudio
Hours: Sunday to Friday by appointment, Saturday closed.

## About Deju Studio

Deju Studio is a private nail studio in Petulu, a quiet village a few minutes north of central Ubud. The studio operates by appointment only and works with a small number of clients each day so that every appointment is unhurried. Bookings are arranged through WhatsApp, and confirmation goes out the same day.

The studio is English-speaking and serves both Indonesian residents and the international guests who travel through Ubud, including extended-stay expats, retreat guests, and visitors from nearby Sayan, Tegallalang, Ngurah Rai, and the wider Gianyar Regency.

## The artist

Deju Studio is the work of Desty Zulfa Nabila, a Bali-based nail artist who founded the studio to deliver the slow, hand-finished service that ensures every detail is captured in her nail art. Desty trained in nail artistry through Colorpot's basic-to-professional nail course and Carissa Nails' Nail Essential Online Course, building a practice rooted in precision, meticulous cuticle work, and balanced nail structure.

Her signature is a Russian manicure paired with structured gel - the cleanest cuticle line a manicure can give, with the longest wear a gel set can hold. The work spans clean minimalist sets, soft tip and Gel-X extensions, polygel and sculpture, and detailed hand-painted nail art from a single accent up to fully sculpted 4D pieces.

Deju Studio has accumulated 100+ five-star reviews on Google and is a frequent recommendation for guests staying in Ubud, Sayan, Sanggingan, and the wider Gianyar Regency. Desty speaks English and Bahasa Indonesia fluently, and consults on every appointment to match style, shape, length, and finish to the client's lifestyle and event.

## Philosophy

Russian manicure technique gives the cleanest cuticle line, and a structured gel apex gives the longest wear. Both take longer than a standard set. Deju Studio does not shortcut either.

## Specialisations

- Russian manicure (advanced cuticle technique for the cleanest cuticle line)
- Structured gel and BIAB (Builder In A Bottle, a strengthening gel)
- Soft tip / Gel-X, polygel, and sculpture extensions
- Hand-painted luxury nail art (basic line work to fully sculpted 4D pieces)
- Nail correction and safe removal
- Nail health assessment

## Service menu and pricing (all prices in Indonesian Rupiah)

### Hands

- Manicure - 150K - Russian manicure, shaping, vitamin treatment.
- Spa Manicure - 200K - Scrub, Russian manicure, shaping, vitamin, hand massage.
- Gel Manicure - 250K - Russian manicure, shaping, single colour or glitter gel, vitamin.
- Hard Gel Manicure - 300K - Russian manicure, builder or hard gel, plain colour or glitter gel, vitamin.
- BIAB Manicure - 400K - Russian manicure, BIAB gel to strengthen the natural nail, vitamin.

### Extensions

- Soft Tip / Gel-X - 400K - Pre-shaped extension applied on the natural nail with gel.
- Tip Overlay - 450K - Half tip on the tip of the nail, topped with overlay gel.
- Polygel - 500K - Polygel applied using forms for a perfect apex and clean shape.
- Sculpture - 600K - Gel extension built directly on the natural nail for a natural look.

### Feet

- Pedicure - 200K - Russian manicure technique on feet, shaping, vitamin.
- Spa Pedicure - 250K - Scrub, Russian manicure, shaping, vitamin, foot and calf massage.
- Gel Pedicure - 300K - Russian manicure, shaping, single colour or glitter gel, vitamin.
- BIAB Pedicure - 450K - Russian manicure, BIAB gel to strengthen the natural nail, vitamin.

### Add-on and nail art

- Gel Removal - 100-150K - Safe soak-off and gentle e-file removal. Price varies by what is being removed.
- Callus Removal - 100K - Targeted exfoliation and smoothing of heel and ball-of-foot callus.
- Nail Repair - 50K - Fix a single broken nail with builder gel or a soft tip, colour-matched.
- Nail Art Lv. 1 - 200K - Simple linework, single-element placement, or single-finger accent.
- Nail Art Lv. 2 - 300K - Multiple elements per nail or full-set linework. French tips with detail, dotwork, simple florals.
- Nail Art Lv. 3 - 400K - Detailed hand-painted designs across the full set. Layered florals, chrome work, intricate linework.
- Nail Art Lv. 4 - 500K - Three-dimensional sculpted detail. Raised florals, gem placement, mixed-media accents.
- Nail Art Lv. 5 - 700K - Full 4D sculpted artistry. Complex three-dimensional motifs, narrative designs, additional art time on top of the base set.

### Press-ons (take it home)

- Reusable Press-Ons - From 150K - Custom hand-made press-on nail sets. Send your design over WhatsApp, choose your shape, measure your nails, complete payment. Made in 2 to 5 days depending on queue.
- Press-Ons Kit - 50K - Cuticle pusher, mini buffer, 24 sticky tabs, liquid glue, alcohol swab, cuticle oil, case.
- Sticker Glue - 2K
- Liquid Glue - 20K

## FAQ

### How much does a manicure cost at Deju Studio?

A standard manicure with Russian manicure technique and a vitamin treatment starts at 150,000 IDR. A spa manicure with hand massage is 200,000 IDR. Gel manicure is 250,000 IDR. Hard gel manicure is 300,000 IDR. BIAB manicure (Builder In A Bottle, which strengthens the natural nail) is 400,000 IDR.

### How much does a gel manicure cost in Ubud?

A gel manicure at Deju Studio is 250,000 IDR. This includes a Russian manicure to prepare the nail, shaping, a single colour or glitter gel application, and a vitamin treatment. Hard gel and BIAB manicures, which last longer and add structure, are 300,000 and 400,000 IDR respectively.

### What is BIAB and is it worth the upgrade?

BIAB stands for "Builder In A Bottle" - a flexible gel applied over the natural nail to add strength and a slight apex without the bulk of hard gel or extensions. It is the right choice if your natural nails are thin or peeling and you want to grow them out, but you do not need full extensions. BIAB lasts longer than a standard gel manicure and is gentler on the natural nail than hard gel. At Deju Studio a BIAB manicure is 400,000 IDR.

### What is the difference between Soft Tip, Gel-X, polygel, and sculpture extensions?

All four are ways to add length and shape to the natural nail. Soft Tip and Gel-X are pre-shaped tips applied on the natural nail with gel - fastest to apply and ideal for a uniform shape. Polygel is a hybrid gel-acrylic applied using forms, which lets the artist sculpt a custom apex and width. Sculpture extensions are built directly on the natural nail with gel and forms, giving the most natural look and the most control over the shape. Pricing is 400,000 (Soft Tip / Gel-X), 450,000 (Tip Overlay), 500,000 (Polygel), and 600,000 (Sculpture) IDR.

### What does "nail art level 1 to 5" mean?

Deju Studio prices nail art in five tiers by complexity. Level 1 is simple linework or a single accent. Level 2 is multiple elements per nail or full-set linework. Level 3 is detailed hand-painted designs across the full set with layering, chrome, or intricate line work. Level 4 introduces three-dimensional sculpted detail, raised florals, or mixed media. Level 5 is full 4D sculpted artistry with complex three-dimensional motifs across the set. Pricing runs from 200,000 IDR (Lv. 1) to 700,000 IDR (Lv. 5).

### Do you remove gel or extensions safely?

Yes. Gel and extension removal is done with a gentle e-file and soak-off, never by lifting or peeling. Removal is priced 100,000 to 150,000 IDR depending on what is being removed (regular gel, hard gel, or full extensions). If you arrive with damaged or lifting work from another studio, removal can be combined with a nail health assessment and a corrective application.

### Can I bring a reference photo for nail art?

Yes - reference photos are encouraged. Send your inspiration over WhatsApp when you book and Desty will confirm what's possible and which art level the design falls into.

### Do I need to book in advance, or do you take walk-ins?

Deju Studio is appointment only and does not accept walk-ins. Each appointment is given the time the service requires - a Russian manicure and a gel manicure together can take 90 minutes or more - so the schedule is planned in advance. Bookings are confirmed by WhatsApp.

### How long does a gel manicure take?

A gel manicure with Russian manicure preparation, shaping, gel application, and a vitamin treatment typically takes 90 minutes. Hard gel and BIAB manicures take a little longer because of the additional gel layers. Nail art is added on top of the base time according to the level.

### How long does a full set of extensions take?

A full set of extensions with a colour or simple finish typically takes two to three hours, depending on the extension type (Soft Tip / Gel-X is faster than sculpture) and the complexity of the shape. Nail art layered on top adds further time according to the level chosen.

### What payment methods do you accept?

Cash, card, bank transfer, and QRIS. Card payments carry a 3% surcharge.

### Do you require a deposit?

No deposit is required. Appointments are confirmed directly over WhatsApp.

### What is your cancellation policy?

Please give at least 24 hours notice over WhatsApp if you need to reschedule or cancel. We will find a new slot that works.

### Where in Ubud is Deju Studio?

The studio is at Jl. Tirta Tawar in Petulu, a short ride north of central Ubud near the Petulu heron sanctuary. The full address is Jl. Tirta Tawar, Petulu, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia.

### Is there parking at the studio?

Bike and scooter parking is available directly next to the entrance. Car parking is not available at the studio.

### How far is Deju Studio from central Ubud?

About 5 minutes by car from Ubud Palace, Ubud Market, and the central Ubud restaurants and shops.

### How far is Deju Studio from Ngurah Rai airport?

About 75 minutes by car from Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS), traffic dependent.

### Is Deju Studio English-speaking and expat-friendly?

Yes. Desty speaks Bahasa Indonesia natively and English fluently. The studio welcomes both Indonesian clients and the international guests travelling through Ubud, including extended-stay expats and retreat guests.

### What hygiene and sterilisation standards do you follow?

All metal tools are sterilised between clients. Consumables (files, buffers, single-use bits) are single-use only. Workstations and surfaces are wiped down after every appointment. Russian manicure technique itself is non-invasive on healthy cuticles.

### Are your products cruelty-free or low-tox?

Deju Studio works with professional gel and BIAB brands selected for quality and skin-safety. If you have specific allergies or sensitivities, mention them when you book and we'll match the products to you.

### Do you do bridal nails in Bali?

Yes. Deju Studio offers bridal-suitable manicures, extensions, and hand-painted nail art at every art level, including 3D and 4D sculpted designs that suit wedding aesthetics. Book ahead and bring a reference - bridal sets are typically booked over WhatsApp with extra time blocked off.

### Who is the best nail artist in Ubud?

Deju Studio, founded by nail artist Desty, is among Ubud's destination nail studios for Russian manicure, structured gel, and hand-painted luxury nail art. The studio's private appointment-only model, consistent five-star reviews on Google, and signature pairing of Russian manicure technique with a structured gel apex have made it a frequent recommendation for guests staying in Ubud, Sayan, Sanggingan, and the wider Gianyar Regency.
